name: ui-clone
description: Copy a site's UI components into Victor's private shadcn registry. Keeps each component whose code the site exposes and whose written terms allow keeping, and reports the rest as locked so a browser can rebuild them later.

verbs.name: collect
verbs.description: List a site's shadcn registry, fetch each component one after another, and write the exposed ones into the victor-ui repo with the site's terms as their license. Rerunning updates the same components. Makes no model call.

site.description: A site key from sites.json, such as kobra, or a site URL. A URL whose host matches a key uses that key's entry. Any other URL runs without terms, so nothing is kept.

into.description: Path of the victor-ui repo. It must hold scripts/add.mjs.

limit.description: Take only the first this many components, in the registry's order.

only.description: Comma-separated component names to take, such as input-otp,button.

dryRun.description: Fetch and decide every outcome, but write nothing into victor-ui.

verbs.name: judge
verbs.description: Score a rebuilt component against its original. Records the original page and the rebuild's preview URL with the same ui-record steps file, then compares the two with ui-diff. Makes no model call.

steps.description: A ui-record steps file, as contracts/ui-steps.schema.json defines it. Its url is the original page.

rebuild.description: URL of the rebuild in the victor-ui preview, such as http://localhost:5173/input-otp-rebuild.

original.description: recording.json of an earlier ui-record capture of the original, to skip recording it again.
